state: Sellers drive price down to 0.823, breaking the latest confirmed low and riding the lower Bollinger band.
paragraphs: Sellers hold the immediate advantage, pressing price down to 0.823 and breaking the latest confirmed low pivot at 0.8235. The decline features an aggressive recent extension reaching 9 units of downward movement in the latest sequence, showing sharp near-term force. That descent is riding the lower Bollinger band at 0.82366, confirming that the downside pressure remains active. Even so, the wider market structure shows conflicting signals. While the immediate run has stretched lower, the structural quality remains unstable and timing consistency stays low. Price is not yet executing a clean, orderly trend. Instead, the sharp drop is testing important harmonic support around the 0.823 mark, creating immediate friction as sellers try to extend their control against the broader backdrop.

Broader history across the full 104-brick window shows that bullish advances historically held the upper hand in duration, averaging 4.36 units compared to an average bearish run of 2.87. But the recent sequence reveals a notable shift beneath the surface. Over the last 12 runs, selling pressure has intensified and stretched out. The longest bearish run matches the absolute peak of the sample at 9 units, while the average bearish run has expanded to 3.5. Meanwhile, bullish counter-moves have shortened to an average of 3.33 units. While the wider market remains structurally unsettled, the immediate balance of energy has tilted clearly toward the downside as sellers stretch their sequence length and dominate the most recent moves.

The recent downside extension packs strong momentum, yet the broader operational backdrop remains distinctly unsettled. Continuation stands at 68.8 while compression stays subdued at 11.0, showing that price is pushing downward with active force but encountering little internal resistance or coiling behavior to steady the move. Transition pressure at 49.0 and a moderate chop reading of 42.4 confirm that control is frequently contested underneath the surface, even as sellers maintain their immediate grip. This combination reveals a forceful directional thrust operating within a fractured structural environment. The descent is sharp, but the low timing consistency and conflicting internal readings mean sellers are pressing an advantage without a stable trend foundation.

Immediate support clusters right at current price around 0.823, anchored by harmonic completion and reinforced by the lower Bollinger band at 0.82366. Below that zone, earlier swing levels sit down near 0.8205 and 0.8195. Overhead, the first resistance area rests at the broken low pivot of 0.8235 and the nearby high pivot of 0.825. Beyond those immediate barriers, a thicker resistance cluster forms around the middle Bollinger band at 0.83122 and SAR at 0.83398. The larger trend-control area stretches further up toward the confirmed high pivots near 0.837 and 0.838. These zones mark where sellers must maintain downward pressure to keep their advantage intact, while any recovery would first need to reclaim the immediate resistance band to challenge that control.

The volatility envelope remains broad with stable width, giving price ample room to keep moving downward even though fresh volatility is no longer expanding behind the selloff. Moderate opposing wick pressure of 35.8 indicates that rejection from current levels is present but not yet forceful enough to stop the decline. At the same time, a bullish Bat pattern is developing around 0.823, introducing notable counter-pressure right at the edge of the move. This harmonic structure serves as a source of friction instead of a confirmed reversal, signaling that buyers are beginning to contest the lows without having the evidence required to overturn the broader downward momentum.

Unresolved market conditions persist while rapid switching, erratic timing, and frequent reversals keep the wider background unsettled. That disorder fades only if the market establishes order through a stable range or persistent directional control. The current bearish lean becomes more convincing only when instability decreases and sellers generate repeated runs, steadier timing, and continued structural progress below immediate support. Conversely, that downside lean becomes weaker if buyers reclaim broken structure like the 0.8235 pivot or extend counter-runs beyond recent averages. A stable range can replace the unresolved background without automatically reversing the immediate directional bias, leaving the market to prove whether the current selling pressure can sustain its force.
